Hi Alicia — thanks, this is straightforward. Quick answers and proposed plan below.

- Executing signer: Daniel Park, CFO, Redwood Inference (will appear as signatory on the MSA).
- Delegated signing: we are fine with delegated signing for the Order Form only (your VP can sign the order form provided a countersign is not required on our side). Please confirm the delegate's name and title so we can set the routing rules.
- Signing window: 7/11–7/12 (two business days) looks good on our calendar.
- Clean copies: we will deliver a final PDF/A clean copy within 24 hours of the last signature. Connor will upload the clean copy to the shared s3 record and send the link.
- Notarization/witness: Redwood does not require notarization for this agreement; witness blocks are not required. If Pemberton's legal requires witnessing, flag it and we'll loop legal.

Proposed DocuSign routing (to save time):
1) MSA — sequential: Redwood CFO (Daniel Park) -> Pemberton Exec (Bob Li)
2) Order Form — parallel to speed: Pemberton VP (delegate) + Redwood Sales Ops (Connor)

I've looped Marissa (legal) and Connor (contracts ops) to validate the routing and take the envelope through finalization. If you send the delegate name, we'll preconfigure the recipient role in DocuSign.

Thanks — Hannah
